name: mn-trono
description: Aplicativo desktop, web e mobile de comunicação e jogos — Base Fluxer + Cloudflare Realtime SFU

scripts.desktop:package: npm run build:web && npm --prefix apps/desktop run pack:win
scripts.build:manual: node scripts/build-law-assets.js && node scripts/build-manual.js && node scripts/print-manual.js
scripts.build:packages: npm --workspace=@trono/protocol run build && npm --workspace=@trono/voice-engine run build
scripts.build:server: npm run build:packages && npm --workspace=@trono/server run typecheck
scripts.build:web: npm run build:packages && node scripts/prepare-renderer.cjs && npm --workspace=@trono/web run build && node scripts/prepare-static-html.cjs
scripts.deploy:surge: npm run build:web && npx --yes surge@0.46.0 ./apps/web/out a-lei-do-trono.surge.sh
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm --workspace=@trono/web run typecheck && npm --workspace=@trono/server run typecheck
scripts.format: prettier --write packages apps tests scripts .github/workflows README.md AGENTS.md docs
scripts.format:check: prettier --check packages apps tests scripts .github/workflows README.md AGENTS.md docs
scripts.test:unit: npm run build:packages && node scripts/test.cjs --layer unit
scripts.test:integration: npm run build:packages && node scripts/test.cjs --layer integration
